DelayedCommittedEventVsRollbackGap.FundamentalDifference: A rollback gap never commits to PostgreSQL, so no data exists in outbox. A delayed committed event commits to PostgreSQL and exists in outbox, but has not completed in-memory projection.

DelayedEventBehavior.Explanation: ContiguousWatermarkTracker held watermark at 0 because seq 1 was still in-flight, preventing recovery checkpoints from skipping seq 1.
